# Isaiah Chapter 11 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 146r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_011_page_001.jpg

---

**11:1** And-a-shoot [choter] will-go-out [veyatsa] from-the-stump [mi-geza] of-Yishai [Jesse], and-a-branch [netser] from-his-roots [mi-shorashav] will-bear-fruit [yifreh].

**11:6** And-the-wolf [ze'ev] will-dwell [vegar] with-the-lamb [keves], and-the-leopard [namer] with-the-kid [gedi] will-lie-down [yirbats]; and-the-calf [egel] and-the-young-lion [kefiyr] and-the-fatling [u-meri] together [yachdav] — and-a-little-child [na'ar qaton] leading [noheg] them.

**11:9** They-will-not harm [lo yare'u] and-will-not destroy [lo yashchitu] in-all my-holy [qodshi] mountain [har]; for the-earth [ha-arets] will-be-full [male'ah] of-the-knowledge [de'ah] of-YHWH as-the-waters [ka-mayim] covering [mekhassim] the-sea [la-yam].

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "a shoot from the stump of Jesse":** *Geza* is a stump — what remains after a tree is cut down. The Davidic dynasty has been reduced to a stump, but new growth emerges. *Netser* ("branch") may be the origin of "Nazarene" (Matthew 2:23).

**v.6-9 — The peaceable kingdom:** Wolf and lamb, leopard and kid, lion and calf — predator-prey relationships dissolved. A child leads them all. "The earth will be full of the knowledge of YHWH as the waters cover the sea" — perhaps the single most expansive vision of restoration in the prophets.

*— EMET*
